Zoe Chen: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Malik and the infra squad for getting the staging GPU pool back up after the midnight OOM. Saved my demo tomorrow 🙌
Malik Patel: oh yay, glad it worked! was a weird mem leak in the batcher, added a guard and a test.
Priya Nair: Massive :tada: to Malik. Also — Sam left detailed rollback steps in the runbook, that was clutch.
Sam Ortiz: np! left a small follow-up in eng-runtime ticket with a snippet: `export BATCH_MAX=128` + restart hook.
Jules: appreciate the teamwork — saw the alerts late and really felt supported. pizza on me next week? :pizza:
Emma Li: Love that. Also shoutout to Priya for triaging support threads so quickly while this was happening. customer impact minimized.
kudos-bot: :clap: New kudos recorded: Zoe gave a kudos to Malik, Priya, and Sam for incident response (1 point each).
Malik Patel: thanks Zoe, Priya, Sam — everyone jumped in fast. feels good to have the playbook actually work.
Priya Nair: team effort. if anyone wants the runbook diff I can paste it here later.
Zoe Chen: please do — would be great for onboarding notes. And Jules — pizza confirmed, thanks! :smile:
